verdict.rationale: Typesense is open-source (GPL) and documented as installable via Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, Homebrew, DEB/RPM packages, and Linux/Mac binaries, with production-hardening guides for security, monitoring, and scaling. A hands-on probe confirms a fully self-hosted local instance was installed via Homebrew, booted with a self-set API key with no account or cloud dependency, and performed a real typo-tolerant search roundtrip. Missing for 10: no independent third-party audit of self-hosted production scaling beyond community anecdotes about memory usage.
